elimination_replay_system.status: Temporarily disabled in patch for further fixes

future_parameters.minimap_display: Hidden during replay to prevent location leaking

vehicle_destruction_mechanic.new_behavior: Players are ejected upon vehicle explosion and sustain explosion damage instead of instant death

settings_ui_overhaul.visual_explanations: Added graphical and textual guides for Controls and Sensitivity options
settings_ui_overhaul.precise_slider_adjustment: Added +/- 1 unit step buttons for Sensitivity and Sound sliders

sp_display_option.effect: Shows Shield Points as numbers and collapses EP bar

hud_and_settings_redesign.charge_buster_audio_alert: Enemies receive immediate audio/visual alert when an opposing Charge Buster is charging
hud_and_settings_redesign.homer_targeting_priority: Prioritizes active/alive enemies over knocked down enemies

preset_and_character_ui.character_page: Added simplified vs detailed skill descriptions toggle with updated skill tags
preset_and_character_ui.recommended_preset_page: Redesigned entrance, added preset options, and streamlined setup process

rank_and_matchmaking_qol.rank_guidance_popups: Displays progress towards ranking up, season end warnings, friend rank surpass alerts, and daily mission status
rank_and_matchmaking_qol.spectator_endorsement: Eliminated players can endorse teammates or enemies while spectating
rank_and_matchmaking_qol.voice_reconnection_indicator: In-match HUD icon appears when attempting to reconnect to voice servers
rank_and_matchmaking_qol.team_recommendation_stats: Prioritizes KDA, headshot rate, Booyah streak, and Weapon Glory rankings
rank_and_matchmaking_qol.penalty_indicator: Displays misconduct/penalty icon on result screen for AFK or force quits

custom_room_features.afk_auto_kick: Automatically removes long-term offline players from custom rooms
custom_room_features.war_chest_toggle: Added option to enable/disable War Chests in BR custom rooms

account_security.recovery_email: Allows binding a private recovery email to switch social media logins via verification codes
